_why: The point labels A, B, C and D on the temperature-vs-time graph are drawn as vector art, so PyMuPDF cannot see them: the chapter's PROSE names only 'line AB' and 'Line BC' and never mentions C or D, while the figure itself plainly prints all four letters. The same graph appears twice — as fig. 5.2 in the body (PDF idx 72, printed p63) and again as the unnumbered graph of Exercise Q5 (idx 80, printed p71) — and both carry the identical A/B/C/D lettering, verified on the rendered pages at magnification. These labels are transcribed off those renders and attributed to the figures they come from, so that a genuine invention still stands out from a figure-only label.
